title: Golf & Disc Golf Cross-Feed Daily Correlation
dataSources: Golf rounds (`golf:round`), Garmin golf telemetry (`garmin:golf`), UDisc rounds (`udisc:round`), launch-monitor shots (`launchmonitor:shot`), handicap-index updates (`handicap:index`).
app: Arccos and Garmin S62 round telemetry, UDisc round exports, launch-monitor CSVs, and handicap-index updates streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted imports.
spl:
(index=personal sourcetype=golf:round) OR (index=personal sourcetype=udisc:round)
| bin _time span=1d
| eval feed=case(sourcetype="golf:round","primary",sourcetype="udisc:round","secondary",1=1,"other")
| stats count as events by _time feed
| chart sum(events) over _time by feed
description: Lines up daily volume from golf:round and udisc:round to see whether two golf feeds move together.
value: When two related exports diverge — one busy, one silent — it usually means a connector broke on only one path.
implementation: Forward both `golf:round` and `udisc:round` into `index=personal` and compare daily counts on one chart.
visualization: Dual-line chart of daily events per sourcetype.
grandmaExplanation: It shows whether your two main golf data feeds rise and fall together or if one of them quietly stopped keeping up.
